name: The Deadline
source:
Picture it: you're a young writer who has just finished writing his first novel. Now it's time to party, right? Not so fast! You just found out you have to completely rewrite it, and you only have 8 days to do so! Impossible? Not if you have your own characters by your side - but will you be able to satisfy their weird demands?

In “The Deadline,” a Visual Novel developed by NDE Visual, a team of Italian writers, publishers, and artists, you will take on the role of Ramfis, a wannabe writer in his twenties with a mess of a life, and you'll have the chance (and duty) to rewrite his novel according to your choices. But to do so, you’ll have to face the judgement... of your own characters! Are you ready to endure Scott's annoying blabbering, Dee Dee's terrifying threats, Barry's disgusting jokes, and Elizabeth's witty banter? And in the end, will you be able to write a novel that pleases everyone?

If you ever, at least once in your life, thought about writing a novel, "The Deadline" will let you realize your dreams! As Ramfis, you will live through the joys and sorrows, hopes and frustrations of a young writer in the grip of his own characters, subjected to their tribulations and ambitions.
And if you don't care much about writing, fear not: with the colorful cast and absurd situations into which the poor writer will be dragged, laughter will not be scarce!

[From [url=http://www.natividigitaliedizioni.it/the-deadline-demo-press-kit/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
想象一下：你是一位刚刚写完第一部小说的年轻作家。现在是聚会的时候了，对吧？没那么快！你刚刚发现你必须完全重写它，而且你只有8天的时间！不可能的？如果你身边有自己的角色，那就不行了——但你能满足他们奇怪的要求吗？

在由意大利作家、出版商和艺术家组成的NDE Visual团队开发的视觉小说《The Deadline》中，你将扮演Ramfis的角色，一个二十多岁的想成为作家、生活一团糟的人，你将有机会（和责任）根据你的选择重写他的小说。但要做到这一点，你必须面对……你自己角色的判断！你准备好忍受斯科特烦人的喋喋不休、迪迪的可怕威胁、巴里的恶心笑话和伊丽莎白的俏皮玩笑了吗？最终你能写出一部令大家满意的小说吗？

如果你一生中至少有一次想过写一本小说，《最后期限》将让你实现你的梦想！作为拉姆菲斯，你将经历一个年轻作家的欢乐和悲伤、希望和挫折，在他自己的角色的掌控下，承受他们的磨难和野心。
如果你不太关心写作，也不必担心：可怜的作家将被拖入丰富多彩的演员阵容和荒谬的情境中，笑声不会稀缺！
